source_only_checks.independent_readonly_review: Flat/inverse/JSON projection/API inheritance/state counts/RunState/files/schema reviewed. Two identified granularity gaps were added as per-step targeted-count and global-signal identity checks. No successful run is claimed.

output_schema.input_bindings: actual absolute path -> {bytes,sha256}; success includes actual receipt/gzip/runner/guard/plan/formal-source-review/three PNGs

command_note: Set --final-dir to the actual root executed directory of exact runner+guard+plan (if copied to.compat, use /workspace/.compat). Report path must be new and external. Root alone executes after Wine completes.
limitations: Self-runner hash/plan SHA are absent from original runtime receipt; root process provenance must bind actual executed artifacts.
Python RunState object identity and technical-view transitions are source-bound runner assertions, not independently saved proofs.
PNG bytes/CRC/metadata do not prove pixel visibility; root must view all three actual images.
Draft has only AST/source review; root first execution may reveal a validator defect. Such a defect is not automatically a product or Wine failure.
